parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: HAZOP framing: The node is V-001 and associated lines (CASE-01). The implied design intent is to receive well flow and discharge separated liquid through the outlet lines at controlled flow. Guideword LESS gives the deviation: less flow in the separator and outlet lines (CASE-02). Causes are a spurious SDV-30010 firing or a partial well shutdown after electrical-system failure (P2). The consequence, which is the target event, is generator stoppage, SD 2 plant shutdown and inability to discharge liquid from V-001 (P3). Safeguards are FAL-103 and flow control (P1, CASE-03). FAL-103 is detective and relies on operator response, and flow control is a regulatory loop. Neither is shown to prevent the random initiating failures, so they limit rather than eliminate escalation. Probability: The event requires a random initiator within 30 operating days plus escalation to all three consequence elements. P3 states there is no diagnostic trend, verified initiating fault or confirmed occurrence, so only a generic base rate applies. I judge the combined initiator frequency to be about 1 per year or less, and the window is about 8% of a year. With partial conditional escalation, this gives about 3%. Predictability is about 15%. The mechanism is foreseeable in type because the HAZOP documents the causes and consequences, but no precursor makes occurrence within this horizon predictable. Negligence: none. The scenario was identified and safeguards were assigned, and the pre-event record shows no ignored warning, known fault or compliance gap. Qualitative risk, for prioritization only: likelihood is low over the horizon, and severity is at least operational (plant shutdown). Safety and environmental severity are not stated, and the source rating is not inferred. Recommendations: Verify the FAL-103 setpoint, proof testing and operator response time. Review the SDV-30010 spurious-trip history and the reliability of its trip logic and solenoid. Confirm whether generator fuel supply and liquid-discharge capability depend on separator flow or normal power, and whether backup or ride-through provisions exist.
